title: BJP seeks re-test after Sikh youth barred from Himachal patwari exam

ai.summary: BJP demands re-exam for Sikh candidate barred from Himachal patwari exam over religious articles, threatening agitation if not granted.

facts.claim: BJP demands re-exam for Sikh candidate barred from Himachal patwari exam over religious articles
facts.quote: The Himachal Pradesh BJP on Friday demanded a re-examination for the patwari post exclusively for an Amritdhari Sikh candidate who was allegedly barred from appearing in the state exam over ‘kara’ and ‘kirpan’.

facts.claim: BJP threatens agitation if re-exam not granted
facts.quote: Gurmeet said if the government fails to hold the re-exam, the BJP minority morcha, along with a large number of Sikhs of Paonta Sahib and the affected student’s family, would stage a dharna in front of the SDM office.

ai.background_note: Sikh candidates barred from Himachal patwari exam due to religious articles, with BJP and SGPC demanding re-exam.
